source_delta: No kairo-ecs-abm source changes since the bound source base were included in the reviewed adoption commit.

canonical_golden.method: Constructed the specified tag, version, units, sorted node/edge fields, and length-framed UTF-8 mode using Python struct little-endian encodings.

prior_review_disposition.canonical_encoding: Resolved: exact domain tag, NUL terminators, u32/u64 little-endian widths, ordering, byte framing, overflow behavior, no trailing bytes, and excluded fields are frozen.
prior_review_disposition.movement_mode_validation: Resolved: exact UTF-8 byte bounds 1..1024 inclusive, control and boundary-whitespace rejection, internal whitespace allowance, and no normalization/case-folding are explicit.
prior_review_disposition.exports: Resolved: only kairo_ecs_abm::spatial is approved; no crate-root aliases or extra dependency/DES/calibration changes.
prior_review_disposition.getter_smoke: Resolved as a pre-acceptance gate: external fixture exercises route/profile/segment getters and verifies route graph bytes against the graph bytes.
prior_review_disposition.runner_exact_once_note: Resolved: adoption text corrects the earlier caveat; distinct expected test names plus the exact nine-pass single-target summary imply once each, subject to saved log/hash inspection.

remaining_review_note.finding: The smoke confirms exact retention for composed/decomposed Unicode and case-distinct mode strings, but does not directly compare canonical_bytes for graphs differing only by those mode identities. The frozen encoding does specify raw UTF-8 bytes, so there is no ambiguity in the API decision; an explicit inequality oracle would make this identity guarantee more direct.
remaining_review_note.recommendation: Before API acceptance, add a small assertion that otherwise-identical graphs using (for example) Walk versus walk and é versus e plus combining acute have different canonical bytes. Do not treat the present review as runtime or implementation evidence.

disposition: No remaining design blocker to dispatching the bounded implementation under the adopted API. API acceptance remains contingent on the documented external smoke and native/toolchain/algorithm/hosted gates; the noted canonical-identity assertion is recommended before acceptance. This readback does not qualify runtime behavior, full C2.3, or stable-release readiness.
